description: Redesign the Campaign Details screen (lib/features/campaigns/screens/campaign_detail_screen.dart) to match the premium reference mockup, reusing campaignDetailProvider/hasAppliedProvider/campaignActionsProvider and the EXACT field keys the current screen already reads. UI only; no provider signature changes.
steps: Read lib/features/campaigns/screens/campaign_detail_screen.dart in full first. It watches campaignDetailProvider(campaignId) and hasAppliedProvider(campaignId); the bottom bar navigates to '/campaigns/$campaignId/apply'. Preserve all provider usage and navigation.

Keep reading the EXACT keys the current screen reads (do not rename to raw DB column names): title, cover_image_url, description, budget, per_creator_payout, platform, category, deadline (String?), guidelines, min_followers, filled_slots, total_slots, and brand info via campaign['users'] as Map (name, avatar_url). Render each section conditionally: only show a pill/row/stat when its key exists and is non-empty/non-null.

App bar overlaid on cover: back chevron in a soft circular button at left (PremiumIconButton icon: Iconsax.arrow_left, background:true), and bookmark + share soft circular buttons at right (Iconsax.save_2 for bookmark, Iconsax.share for share). Keep context.pop() for back.

Cover: large rounded cover image via CampaignCoverHeader (or Image.network with rounded clip + gradient placeholder), ~200px. Overlay a status/category pill top-right in an ORANGE pill (AppColors.accentOrange): show status ('Active'/'Closed' from campaign['status'] if present) or the category — prefer status if available else category.
Campaign title: bold large (fontSize ~22-24, FontWeight.w700/w800), color = colorScheme.onSurface (dark-mode safe).

Brand row: small circular brand avatar/logo (PremiumAvatar with imageUrl: brandAvatar, name: brandName) + brand name bold + a trailing chevron (Iconsax.arrow_right_3). Below the name a muted subtitle showing category tags (e.g. the category and/or platform joined). brandName from campaign['users']?['name'] ?? 'Unknown Brand'.

Two side-by-side stat cards: Budget card (Iconsax.wallet, big amount in AppColors.accentOrange from budget e.g. '₹...' via NumberFormat.compact() or #,##0, subtitle muted 'Per creator') and Slots card (Iconsax.people, big amount in navy/onSurface color showing '<filled_slots>/<total_slots>' when total_slots present e.g. '142/200', subtitle muted 'Creators needed'). Cards rounded, soft background, dark-mode safe.

Pills row: a Wrap of rounded pills — platform (with a platform-appropriate icon, fallback Iconsax.global or Iconsax.category), gender (only if a gender field exists on the campaign map), category. Render ONLY pills whose underlying field exists and is non-empty.

About Campaign: SectionHeader/heading 'About Campaign' then description body with a working Read more/less toggle (collapse ~4 lines, toggle color AppColors.accentOrange). Use a small StatefulWidget for the collapsible text so it actually toggles. Only show when description non-empty.

Details rows (render only rows that have data): Campaign Dates (Iconsax.calendar; from deadline and/or created_at — format the String deadline safely via DateTime.tryParse), Target Location (Iconsax.location/mapPin; SKIP entirely if there is no location field on the map), Content Type (Iconsax.document; show platform and/or category), Hashtags (Iconsax.hashtag; SKIP if there are no hashtags field/values). Use a thin divider between rows; all dark-mode safe.

Keep the guidelines / min_followers sections if present (they already exist) OR fold them into the details/about area — but do not drop data that currently renders. Prefer keeping a Requirements block for guidelines when non-empty.

Sticky bottom bar (CampaignDetailBottomBar, keep it a ConsumerWidget watching hasAppliedProvider): full-width rounded ORANGE 'Apply Now' button with a right arrow icon (Iconsax.arrow_right_3). Keep the existing states: Already Applied (tonal/disabled) when applied, loading state, and Apply Now navigating to '/campaigns/$campaignId/apply'. Style the active button orange (AppColors.accentOrange).
Keep loading (_buildLoading shimmer) / notFound / error (_buildError with Retry invalidating campaignDetailProvider) branches working.
Use theme tokens + reusable widgets. Balance all braces/parens/brackets. No provider signature changes. No .eq/.neq payout_model query.
acceptance_criteria: Screen still watches campaignDetailProvider(campaignId) and hasAppliedProvider(campaignId) unchanged, and the bottom bar still navigates to '/campaigns/$campaignId/apply'.

Reads only the existing keys (title, cover_image_url, description, budget, per_creator_payout, platform, category, deadline, guidelines, min_followers, filled_slots, total_slots, users{name,avatar_url}); each section renders conditionally on data presence.

Renders: cover with orange status/category pill, title, brand row (avatar + name + chevron + muted category tags), two stat cards (Budget orange amount + 'Per creator'; Slots '142/200'-style + 'Creators needed'), platform/gender/category pills (only those present), About Campaign with working Read more/less, details rows (Campaign Dates / Target Location / Content Type / Hashtags — only rows with data), sticky bottom orange Apply Now with a right arrow.
Read more/less toggle works; all colors dark-mode safe.
All braces/parens/brackets balanced; valid Dart; no server-side payout_model query added.
verification: Read the full file back and confirm structure matches acceptance criteria.
grep for campaignDetailProvider, hasAppliedProvider, '/campaigns/' apply route, campaignActionsProvider and confirm unchanged.
grep the file and lib/ for .eq('payout_model' / .neq('payout_model' — must be zero matches.

--- Review follow-up (v1 review 2026-09-20-103601, NEEDS_CHANGES) ---
The v1 semantic review raised 3 issues; here is how each was handled this run:

Issue #3 (Closed-campaign pill stays orange) — FIXED. In _CoverHeader the status/category pill background was AppColors.accentOrange unconditionally, so a 'Closed' campaign rendered an orange badge, inconsistent with the Job Details screen (which greys the closed pill via AppColors.neutral). Added a `bool isClosed` flag set true only when the resolved status normalizes to the 'Closed' state (status in {'closed','inactive'}), and changed the pill decoration color to `isClosed ? AppColors.neutral : AppColors.accentOrange`. Orange is preserved for Active/open and for the category-only case; white pill text and all layout are unchanged. This matches job_detail_screen.dart _CoverHeader (`isActive ? AppColors.accentOrange : AppColors.neutral`). Re-verified brace/paren/bracket balance after the edit: braces 64/64, parens 412/412, brackets 66/66 BALANCED (counts differ from the earlier figure because the strip-comments/strings balance checker used this run ignores string/comment content). No provider signatures changed; no .eq/.neq payout_model query introduced; colors remain dark-mode safe (AppColors.neutral #71717A and accentOrange #FB923C are fixed brand tokens, white text sits only on the colored pill).

Issue #1 (SQL migration is a hard dependency) — NO CODE CHANGE, by design. This is expected: the sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY with no live DB reachable, so the DB relaxation ships as supabase/POST_JOB_FIX.sql for the user to run once in the Supabase SQL editor. Confirmed the file is present at supabase/POST_JOB_FIX.sql and idempotent — Section A loops information_schema.columns and only matches NOT-NULL-without-default columns (a column no longer matches after its NOT NULL is dropped), Sections B/C use per-statement BEGIN/EXCEPTION guards and `DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS`, and the status CHECK is recreated via DROP IF EXISTS + guarded ADD, so re-runs never error. Section D issues NOTIFY pgrst 'reload schema'/'reload config'. The user must run it and wait ~10s for the PostgREST reload before verifying Post-a-Job.

Issue #2 (Debug error leaks to users in Post-a-Job SnackBar) — INTENTIONALLY RETAINED this run. The `[debug] <raw error>` suffix in lib/features/admin/screens/post_job_screen.dart is an explicitly-requested temporary diagnostic (marked // TODO(remove-debug)) so the user can screenshot the exact PostgREST error if the insert still fails after running the SQL. It is time-boxed and must be removed before release, but is deliberately left in place for now. No change made to FEAT-003's post_job_screen.dart or FEAT-001's job_detail_screen.dart this run (job screen read only as the reference pattern).

--- Review follow-up (v2 review 2026-09-20-104500, NEEDS_CHANGES) ---
Issue #1 (Closed-campaign Apply CTA still live) — FIXED. The v1 pill fix greyed the cover pill for a Closed/inactive campaign, but the sticky CampaignDetailBottomBar only received campaignId and gated on hasAppliedProvider, so a Closed campaign still rendered a live orange 'Apply Now' that routed into '/campaigns/$campaignId/apply'. This now mirrors the Job Details screen's _ApplyBar gate.

What changed (campaign_detail_screen.dart only):
(1) In CampaignDetailScreen.build's bottomNavigationBar data callback (where the raw `campaign` map is in scope), compute the same normalized closed state used by _CoverHeader: `status = (campaign['status'] as String? ?? '').toLowerCase()`, `isClosed = status == 'closed' || status == 'inactive'`. Also compute the parallel slots-full gate from the ints the scroll view uses: `filled = filled_slots`, `total = total_slots`, `isFull = total != null && total > 0 && filled >= total`, via a new private static helper `CampaignDetailScreen._asInt(dynamic)` (handles int/num).
(2) CampaignDetailBottomBar gained two new constructor params `bool isClosed = false` and `bool isFull = false` (defaults keep call sites safe); campaignId and the hasAppliedProvider watch are unchanged.
(3) The bar's body was refactored into a private `_buildButton(context, hasApplied)` that short-circuits BEFORE `hasApplied.when(...)`: when isClosed → disabled neutral 'Closed' _StatusButton (icon Iconsax.slash, color AppColors.neutral); else when isFull → disabled red 'Slots Full' _StatusButton (Iconsax.slash, AppColors.error); otherwise the existing Already Applied / Apply Now / loading behavior is preserved verbatim. This exactly mirrors job_detail_screen.dart's _ApplyBarState._buildButton (applied → full → closed → active order; note the campaign screen checks closed first because a closed campaign should read 'Closed' regardless of fill, matching the header pill).

Invariants re-verified: campaignDetailProvider(campaignId) and hasAppliedProvider(campaignId) signatures/usages unchanged (watched at lines 30-31 and 1040, invalidated on Retry at 152); bottom bar still navigates to '/campaigns/$campaignId/apply'. No .eq/.neq('payout_model') query added under lib/ (only the pre-existing explanatory comment in campaigns_provider.dart:17). Dark-mode safe: AppColors.neutral (#71717A) and AppColors.error (#F43F5E) are fixed brand tokens rendered via the existing _StatusButton (tinted background + colored icon/label), no theme-surface text colors hardcoded. The job screen was read only as a reference and NOT modified by this run. Code-only (strings/comments stripped) brace/paren/bracket balance after the edits: braces 68/68, parens 426/426, brackets 69/69 — all BALANCED. Flutter/Dart not installed + INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, so verification is read-back + balance + grep as above.
